mapper.select: select sp.*,ss.step_order from simulation_progress sp LEFT JOIN scenario_step ss ON sp.step_id = ss.step_id where member_id = #{memberId} and sp.progress_id = ( select sp2.progress_id from simulation_progress sp2 where sp2.member_id = sp.member_id and sp2.scenario_id = sp.scenario_id order by sp2.started_at DESC, sp2.progress_id DESC LIMIT 1 )
mapper.insert: insert into simulation_progress(member_id, scenario_id, step_id) values( memberId, scenarioId, stepId )
